<!DOCTYPE root [
  <!ELEMENT root (child)*>
  <!ELEMENT child (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % ent1 "<!ENTITY ent2 'expanded internal entity'>">
  %ent1;
  <!ENTITY ext SYSTEM "nonexistent.ent">
]>
<?xml-stylesheet type="text/xsl" href="style.xsl"?>
<root xmlns="http://example.com/ns1" xmlns:sub="http://example.com/ns2">

    <![CDATA[
      CDATA section containing markup-like strings: <tag>&ent2;</tag>
    ]]>
  </child>
</root>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE catalog [
  <!ELEMENT catalog (item*)>
  <!ELEMENT item (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY base "RootEntity">
  <!ENTITY comp "&base; and More">
  <!NOTATION png SYSTEM "image/png">
  <!ENTITY logo SYSTEM "logo.png" NDATA png>
  <!ENTITY % param "<!ELEMENT note (#PCDATA)>">
  %param;
]>
<?target data-processing-instruction?>
<catalog xmlns="http://schema.org/catalog" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
  <!-- Catalog item entries with embedded entities and CDATA -->
  <item xlink:type="simple">
    ∁
    <![CDATA[
      <note>Internal CDATA note content</note>
    ]]>
  </item>
</catalog>
```

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE archive [
  <!ELEMENT archive (doc)*>
  <!ELEMENT doc (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY section "Standard Section">
  <!ENTITY ref "§ion; - Ref">
]>
<?xml-model href="schema.rng" type="application/xml-relax-ng"?>
<archive xmlns="http://archive.org/ns" xmlns:meta="http://archive.org/ns/meta">
  <!-- Document archive comment -->
  <doc meta:version="2.0">
    <![CDATA[
      Unparsed character data with entity references like &ref; inside CDATA.
    ]]>
    &ref;
  </doc>
</archive>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE document [
  <!ELEMENT document (section)*>
  <!ELEMENT section (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY e1 "Entity One">
  <!ENTITY e2 "&e1; Entity Two">
  <!NOTATION pdf SYSTEM "application/pdf">
  <!ENTITY docfile SYSTEM "file.pdf" NDATA pdf>
]>
<?xml-debug level="high" mode="verbose"?>
<document xmlns="http://xml.org/document" xmlns:ns="http://xml.org/ns">
  <!-- Comment before section element -->
  <section ns:attr="value">
    <![CDATA[
      <!-- Nested comment inside CDATA -->
      <ns:child>&e2;</ns:child>
    ]]>
  </section>
</document>
```

<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE configuration [
  <!ELEMENT configuration (setting)*>
  <!ELEMENT setting (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY globalSetting "Enabled">
  <!ENTITY localSetting "&globalSetting; - Override">
  <!NOTATION txt SYSTEM "text/plain">
  <!ENTITY readme SYSTEM "README.txt" NDATA txt>
]>
<?app-info status="active"?>
<configuration xmlns="http://config.org/ns" xmlns:cfg="http://config.org/ns/cfg">
  <!-- Configuration properties comment block -->
  <setting cfg:name="mode">
    <![CDATA[
      Mode configuration: &localSetting;
    ]]>
  </setting>
</configuration>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE response [
  <!ELEMENT response (payload)*>
  <!ELEMENT payload (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY msg "Server Message">
  <!ENTITY fullMsg "&msg;: Success">
]>
<?xml-log level="info"?>
<response xmlns="http://api.org/response" xmlns:res="http://api.org/response/res">

    ]]>
  </payload>
</response>

<?xml version="1.0"?>

  <!ELEMENT library (book)*>
  <!ELEMENT book (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY author "John Doe">
  <!ENTITY bookInfo "Title by &author;">
]>
<?xml-stylesheet type="text/css" href="lib.css"?>
<library xmlns="http://library.org/ns" xmlns:lib="http://library.org/ns/lib">
  <!-- Library collection comment -->
  <book lib:category="fiction">
    <![CDATA[
      Book description containing entities: &bookInfo;
    ]]>
  </book>
</library>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE project [
  <!ELEMENT project (task)*>
  <!ELEMENT task (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % macro "<!ENTITY taskRef 'SubTask'>">
  %macro;
  <!NOTATION exe SYSTEM "application/x-msdownload">
  <!ENTITY runner SYSTEM "run.exe" NDATA exe>
]>
<?xml-processing-instruction target="build" data="start"?>
<project xmlns="http://project.org/ns" xmlns:p="http://project.org/ns/p">
  <!-- Project build task comment -->
  <task p:priority="high">
    <![CDATA[
      Executing task: &taskRef;
    ]]>
  </task>
</project>
```

<registry xmlns="http://registry.org/ns" xmlns:reg="http://registry.org/ns/reg">
  <!-- Registry database entries comment -->
  <entry reg:key="main">
    <![CDATA[
      Registry entry CDATA block: &val2;
    ]]>
  </entry>
</registry>
